Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The technical specification of the CB rated current = 1250A, rated voltage = 12kv, Breaking capacity = 40KA, spring charging motor = 110Vdc
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohamed, tested at Nag Hammadi 
Hyd. PS, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Halem: HPGC MPIS coordinator, QC 
general director.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Wear safety equipment as helmet shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses ... etc.
Safety fence caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Switch off the CB and withdraw if from the conduit, ground the cable head.
Switch off the DC
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Portable air blower, metal brush
Set of common screw drivers, and cleaning material (arg, cloth)
Graphite grease, grease for lubricating
Work to be Carried Out
Examine the external parts 
of the are extinguishing chamber
Check the presence of any 
up normal noise
Check the presence of over 
heat and flash over at the are extinguishing chamber after opening cycle
Check the presence of 
surface defects or cracks at the arc extinguishing chamber
Check the tightening of 
the bolts, mechanism of operation, moving and fixed contacts
Clean the insulations and 
check for defects or cracks and lubricate the axis
Check the tripping time 
and the connecting time
